info.title: squalify
info.description: Command-line tool that profiles a data file into a deterministic JSON descriptor. Install it as the squalify .NET tool.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Profile one data file into a deterministic JSON descriptor

commands.name: profile
commands.description: Profile a data file and write its descriptor

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the descriptor to this file instead of stdout

options.name: --include-values
options.description: Include literal data values in the descriptor [default: False]

options.name: --include-values-for
options.description: Include literal values only for the named preamble key, annotation label, key=value key or column (repeatable; matched whole, ASCII case-folded)

options.name: --max-bytes
options.description: Read at most this many bytes: a text file is cut after its last whole line (past the limit when the first line is longer), a binary file at the limit. The descriptor gets a scope section, and no file.sha256 unless the whole file was read

options.name: --max-first-record-bytes
options.description: With --max-bytes: fail, profiling nothing, when the first record (line terminator included) is longer than this many bytes, instead of reading it to its end. Off by default

options.name: --layout-only
options.description: Compute only the encoding, dialect, layout regions, header names and row classes, and skip the per-field types, statistics and sketches, the hints and the typed fingerprint. The descriptor says so with layoutOnly: true, and writes null for hints and fingerprint.typed and only the names for each field. --include-values then opens only the preamble and annotation values of the layout (no field values exist) [default: False]
